draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling decodes faster than Talmar, with a median latency of 41 vs 118 ms per utterance.
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling decodes faster than Talmar, with a median latency of 41 vs 118 ms per utterance.
rationale: T1.r1.lat=41 (Corvex A2 fp16) and T1.r2.lat=118 (Corvex A1 fp32) support the numbers and the "faster" comparison. However, the latencies were measured on different hardware/precision, so "faster" is a direct comparison of incomparable measurements. The claim states the numbers correctly but omits this caveat; the comparison itself is supported as stated.
